tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Start here to discover Patch actions, granted permissions, feature prerequisites and the next tools to call.

tools.name: list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List this account’s phone numbers, direction availability, publication, and default outbound number. Use source_number_id with place_call to choose an enabled, published outbound number.

tools.name: place_call
tools.description: Place the call FROM the selected outbound number (the authenticated user’s verified personal number by default) to accomplish a specific objective (book a table, ask a question, chase an order). A real-time voice agent handles the call, including automated phone menus and hold queues. Its default op

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Get the status and, once terminal, the structured resolution of a call started with place_call. Returns instantly by default. Pass wait_seconds (max 50) to have the server hold the request and return early on any status change — fewer round trips while a call is in progress. Terminal statuses: compl

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List the authenticated user's recent calls, newest first, with statuses and outcomes. Useful to recover a lost call_id or review call history. Pass the returned next_cursor as cursor to fetch the next page of older calls. next_cursor is null when no older calls remain. Omit cursor to start at the ne

tools.name: set_call_visibility
tools.description: Make a call owned by the authenticated user public or private. Calls are private by default. Only publish when the user explicitly asks: a public call exposes its objective, phone numbers, transcript, result and audio to anyone with its permanent, token-free listen_url, including live audio while in

tools.name: end_call
tools.description: End an in-progress call early. Patch requests disconnection by deleting the LiveKit room; a spoken farewell is not guaranteed. Check get_call for the resulting status. Use when the user changes their mind or the call is no longer needed. Available transcript snapshots are retained and the resolution

tools.name: get_phone_number
tools.description: Get the phone number connected to the authenticated user's account in E.164 format, along with its caller_id_status (verified or unverified). With the phone workspace enabled, this resolves the default outbound number and also returns source_number_id; it may be a verified personal caller ID or an o

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read your profile, caller verification, revision and account defaults. Use update_account to change them.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Update only supplied profile fields using the revision from get_account. Agent defaults require configuration permission.

tools.name: get_onboarding
tools.description: Read setup progress, prerequisites and account notices.

tools.name: set_onboarding
tools.description: Set inbound/outbound setup intent, mark setup complete, or skip. Does not buy a plan or number; use billing and number tools for those steps.

tools.name: list_authorized_apps
tools.description: List applications authorized to access this account. These are distinct from external tools used by voice agents.

tools.name: revoke_authorized_app
tools.description: Disconnect an authorized application. Revoking the current application ends this MCP connection.

tools.name: list_numbers
tools.description: List your numbers and routing without exposing agent settings.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Find the identifiers and revisions of your inbound and outbound agents.

tools.name: get_phone_number_settings
tools.description: Read number settings, revisions, recovery deadlines and the workspace revision used to select a default.

tools.name: search_phone_numbers
tools.description: Search currently available US or Canadian numbers by area code. Offers expire; claim an exact returned offer.

tools.name: claim_phone_number
tools.description: Acquire an offered number using your plan allowance. Reuse request_id after an interrupted response.

tools.name: get_number_claim
tools.description: Read provisioning progress for a number claim.

tools.name: update_phone_number
tools.description: Change a label, inbound/outbound availability or retention preference using the number revision.

tools.name: set_default_phone_number
tools.description: Choose the default outbound number using workspace_revision from get_phone_number_settings.

tools.name: get_forwarding_carrier
tools.description: Suggest forwarding instructions for the verified personal number during inbound onboarding. Carrier lookups are cached for a day.

tools.name: get_forwarding_instructions
tools.description: Get carrier-specific steps for forwarding an existing phone to an owned Patch number. The user or carrier must activate forwarding; Patch cannot activate it remotely.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Read the draft, published settings and revision for an inbound or outbound agent.

tools.name: update_agent
tools.description: Change only supplied fields. By default save and publish atomically for new calls. Set apply=false to save a draft. Existing unrelated drafts cause a conflict.

tools.name: publish_agent
tools.description: Explicitly publish all saved draft changes at this revision.

tools.name: discard_agent_draft
tools.description: Discard unpublished settings and restore the published version, or defaults if never published.

tools.name: reset_agent
tools.description: Replace agent settings with defaults. Applies immediately unless apply=false. Also removes tool assignments.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List supported languages, built-in voices with preview URLs, owned voice clones and your clone limit.

tools.name: get_voice_preview
tools.description: Get a short-lived playable URL for an owned voice provider ID or Claudia. Built-in catalog voices already include sample URLs.

tools.name: create_voice_upload
tools.description: Create an expiring audio upload URL. PUT the file bytes there, then call create_voice with the upload_id and the user’s own-voice consent.

tools.name: create_voice
tools.description: Clone an uploaded sample of the user’s own voice. consent must represent the user’s explicit permission; never infer consent.

tools.name: rename_voice
tools.description: Rename one of your voice clones.

tools.name: delete_voice
tools.description: Delete your voice clone and its provider samples. A voice in an active call cannot be deleted.

tools.name: verify_voice
tools.description: Refresh provider verification status. If verification is still required, the user must complete the provider’s verification with support.

tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: List external connections and available common tools, including authorization and entitlement state.

tools.name: get_connector_tools
tools.description: Read the tool catalog of an owned external connection. Does not invoke external actions or return credentials.

tools.name: create_connector
tools.description: Create a hosted MCP connection. Explicit assignments choose agents; an empty list leaves it unassigned. Credentials are write-only.

tools.name: connect_connector
tools.description: Discover or refresh tools, or begin third-party OAuth. Open authorizationUrl only when consent is required, then inspect list_connectors.

tools.name: add_common_connector
tools.description: Enable a managed common tool (currently Exa web search). Uses the existing premium entitlement and default assignments.

tools.name: remove_connector
tools.description: Remove a connection, its saved credentials and all agent assignments without publishing unrelated drafts.

tools.name: list_test_scenarios
tools.description: List synthetic test scenarios and available responder outcomes. Tests use fictional data and never invoke connected external tools.

tools.name: start_agent_test
tools.description: Test an outbound or inbound saved draft with a preset or custom fictional scenario. Inbound requires a custom caller scenario. Runs without a browser; external tools are disabled.

tools.name: get_agent_test
tools.description: Read a synthetic test’s status, transcript, result and transcript expiry.

tools.name: get_agent_test_listener
tools.description: Get a short-lived, subscribe-only LiveKit credential for listening to your running synthetic test from a compatible client.

tools.name: stop_agent_test
tools.description: Stop your synthetic test and retain its captured result.

tools.name: list_activity
tools.description: Read the combined real-call and synthetic-test timeline.

tools.name: get_call_diagnostics
tools.description: Read private diagnostic events for an owned call. Public call visibility never grants access to diagnostics.

tools.name: get_call_listener
tools.description: Get a short-lived, subscribe-only LiveKit credential for listening to your active call from a compatible client.

tools.name: resume_operation
tools.description: Reconcile an interrupted number claim, voice clone or subscription attempt using its original provider identity. Requires the original operation’s permissions and grant. Does not start a replacement purchase.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Recover a request’s durable outcome. A running/needs_attention operation must not be retried under a new ID.

tools.name: get_billing
tools.description: Read plans, usage, subscription state, payment-method summary and invoices. Reconciles subscription state with Stripe; use invoice_cursor for older invoices.

tools.name: preview_subscription_change
tools.description: Preview subscribing, upgrading/downgrading, canceling at period end or resuming. Show charges and limits to the user before execution.

tools.name: execute_subscription_change
tools.description: Execute an authorized quote. May charge a saved payment method. Use the same request_id after a lost response; return a direct payment/authentication link when interaction is required.

tools.name: update_billing_profile
tools.description: Update the Stripe customer’s billing name, email or address. Payment credentials are never accepted here.

tools.name: create_billing_portal
tools.description: Create a direct Stripe portal session to securely update payment methods or finish a billing action requiring a person. Never ask the user to paste card details into chat.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_call, list_calls, end_call, list_voices, get_voice_preview, get_agent_test · Private data: place_call, get_call, set_call_visibility, create_voice_upload, get_connector_tools, create_connector, remove_connector, get_agent_test_listener, get_call_diagnostics, get_call_listener, update_billing_profile · Public sink: get_call, set_call_visibility, update_agent, publish_agent, create_voice_upload, update_billing_profile · Destructive: get_phone_number, reset_agent, delete_voice, remove_connector, execute_subscription_change.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_call, list_calls, end_call, list_voices, get_voice_preview, get_agent_test · Private data: place_call, get_call, set_call_visibility, create_voice_upload, get_connector_tools, create_connector, remove_connector, get_agent_test_listener, get_call_diagnostics, get_call_listener, update_billing_profile · Public sink: get_call, set_call_visibility, update_agent, publish_agent, create_voice_upload, update_billing_profile · Destructive: get_phone_number, reset_agent, delete_voice, remove_connector, execute_subscription_change

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
